notes: All results are exploratory benchmark results. No unseen-domain FPR guarantee. No DP or secure aggregation.
Equal candidate counts, not equal wall-clock time; FedNova and SCAFFOLD use SGD and report different step budgets.
Record-level CIs assume independent flows; only four NF domains; no confirmatory mixed-effects inference.

FedRAT is a tolerance-bound prototype, not established novel or distribution-free under shift. Source-domain groups are not physical clients, and in synthetic allocations they do not correspond to client IDs.
Historical Exp03 and Edge score equality cannot be established without their raw original artifacts; new-run audits only.
FedBN is an explicit source-BN-ensemble adaptation for an unseen site; DANN_Source is a source-only adversarial baseline, not unsupervised target adaptation.
